test_runner_reachability_evidence: pytest installed via apt python3-pytest with symlink from py.test to pytest in setup_runtime.sh
notes: Fixed: pytest is now installed via apt python3-pytest with a symlink from /usr/bin/py.test to /usr/bin/pytest. The apt package provides 'py.test', and the symlink ensures 'pytest' command works. This approach avoids pip compatibility issues with older pip versions. Updated setup_runtime.sh and setup_runtime_commands in environment_request.json accordingly.
